capabilities: Play Snake, 2048, Blocks, and Minesweeper in a dedicated tab
Control games with keyboard shortcuts or touch gestures
Track best scores per game, speed level, and board preset
Restore an in-progress game from the workspace layout within a session

summary: Arcade tab that runs Snake, 2048, Blocks, and Minesweeper with keyboard or touch controls, offline, saving high scores in the vault.
